one_line_summary: In September 2026, 28 women in Sunahra Purwa filled and levelled a 300-foot path after a village meeting, and each family received a CFW kit.
learnings: The problem was a path that filled with mud in the rains, so children could not get to school.
A Goonj team held a meeting at the panchayat building and the text says everyone decided together to repair the path first, without showing who proposed it or what else was weighed.
Women did the work over three days and each family then received a kit; the story counts only the women.
The women say they will look after the path themselves, but no arrangement is described.
missing: no description of how the decision was reached
use_note: Usable inside the team now; before outside use, confirm that the named speakers agree to be quoted and add a result with a date.
